items.label: 真题
items.english: Members of social networks are learning that they can hijack media to apply pressure on the businesses that originally created them.
items.translation: 社交网络用户正领悟到，他们可以通过劫持媒体来对最初创建该媒体的企业施加压力。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
items.translation: 一些增长源于各国政府和有远见的企业为更清洁的能源提供资金的一个承诺。
items.reason: 固定搭配起源于，不等于主词所列阻止；另存关联资料。

items.label: 例
items.english: Adapt your usual eating regime to make it more nutritious.
items.translation: 调整你的常饮食习惯，使之更富有营养。

items.label: 真题
items.english: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
items.translation: 本案中用隐私法限制科技巨头似乎稍显牵强。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Children of every age benefit from patient parenting.
items.translation: 每个年龄的孩子都受益于耐心的养育。
